catalogs.title: Kappa / Ur — Galleon Disruption
catalogs.notes: Disruption uses two main intermediate rooms. Mark the pair you spawned. Toggle Reject on rooms you personally abort.

rooms.looks: Mixed sightlines, crate stacks, a bit of clutter. Average demo spacing.
Open hangar-style room. Long sightlines, easy to read demos from mid.
Tight compact room. Demos sit close together — a common keep with 6.
Compact two-level galleon room. Short paths between conduits.
Longer snaking hall. Demos feel spread out; slower keys.
Maze-like with extra corners and verticality. Easy to lose a demo.

catalogs.title: Apollo — Lua Disruption
catalogs.notes: Apollo's two MoonInt rooms decide whether the layout is worth staying.

rooms.looks: Moon garden with planters and open floor. Easy to see demos.
Arched cloister halls. Mixed corners, average spacing.
Short Lua combat room. Compact, readable, often a keep.
Huge hall. Long sprints between conduits.
Power-core Lua room with a central machine and open sides.
Broken plaza with a clear center. Short demo paths.
Dimmer Lua interior with more cover. Mixed readability.
Awkward dented layout. Bad demo angles; often aborted.

catalogs.title: Olympus — Mars Disruption
catalogs.notes: Olympus can pull several CmpIntermediate rooms. Reject the ones you hate running.

rooms.looks: Small settlement yard. Decent demo spacing.
Open camp with a few buildings. Readable from mid.
Average Mars camp. Mixed cover.
Slightly busier camp. Watch extra corners.
Larger dusty yard. Longer runs between keys.
Spread-out camp. Easy to lose a conduit.
Compact settlement tile. Short paths — usually a keep.
Readable camp with a clear center.
Boss-arena style tile. Awkward for Disruption keys.
Long connector hallway used as a combat room. Slow.
